title: 葵Sの後に・乾風の予感

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr runs well in the Aoi Stakes, and goes on to surprise her fans by responding to their cheers of support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Tokai Teio wins the Japanese Derby, her second crown. She's now only a single race away from becoming an undefeated Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Zephyr won't be outshined. We decide to make her next race the Sprinters Stakes, a G1 like the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our plan set, Zephyr—who paid those around her little mind when she debuted—now seems eager to learn about her opponents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her ties to Tokai Teio have helped broaden her perspective, and as a result, two enormous new hurdles come into view.
